# Contributing to bini-image-archive

## Start with the correct application

Run `npm ci`. Configure R2 credentials in `.env.local` before using `npm run dev` or `npm start`; these scripts run `sync:r2` first. The sync command downloads the configured state/library.json to data/library.json. Keep credentials local. `npm run build` is the production build command; it is not proof of working remote storage.

## Keep changes reviewable

Describe the observed problem and the behavior after your change. Keep one concern per pull request; avoid unrelated dependency updates and formatting churn. Read existing repository instructions before changing source.

## Verification

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` in a configured test environment. Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` for dependency-free JavaScript/Python syntax checks once available. Verify public browsing separately from protected moderation routes. Do not run crawlers or forced analysis merely to validate a documentation change.

For browser changes, check 390 × 844, 768 × 1024 and 1440 × 900 viewports. Look for horizontal overflow, clipped controls, readable text and keyboard focus. Record the actual browser and dimensions; a screenshot alone does not prove the whole journey.

Useful end-to-end check: Load the public archive, filter by member/year, load another page, save a favorite and reload. With authorized test moderator access, verify a synthetic report is visible and moderation routes reject unauthenticated requests.

## Handle sensitive data

Never attach R2 credentials, admin review keys, session secrets, private reports or exported moderation state. Redact private object URLs and reporter information.

## Before opening a pull request

- Explain what changed and why.
- List commands actually run and their results; state skipped checks explicitly.
- Include reproducible steps for bug fixes and relevant screenshots for UI changes.
- Describe migration or rollback needs when changing persisted data.

tasks.title: Add dependency-free source syntax checks and CI

files..github/workflows/source-preflight.yml:
name: Source preflight
on:
  push:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['**/*.js', '**/*.mjs', '**/*.cjs', '**/*.py', '**/*.html', '.github/workflows/source-preflight.yml']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: source-preflight-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  syntax:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: python3 scripts/source-preflight.py

# bini-image-archive: troubleshooting and recovery

## Scope

This guide describes the checked-in application as reviewed on 2026-10-10. Confirm current source and deployment configuration before operating on live data.

## Local setup

Run `npm ci`. Configure R2 credentials in `.env.local` before using `npm run dev` or `npm start`; these scripts run `sync:r2` first. The sync command downloads the configured state/library.json to data/library.json. Keep credentials local. `npm run build` is the production build command; it is not proof of working remote storage.

## Diagnose the failing boundary

The startup script syncs the R2 state library before Next.js starts. If startup fails, verify the four R2 variables and access to the configured state/library.json; do not replace the remote library with an empty local array. Public browsing, moderation state and crawler checkpoints have different responsibilities. Back up remote state before migration or bulk moderation. A normal local preflight should not launch crawl:all or analyze:force. Keep existing crawler workflows unchanged unless the change specifically requires it. Verify image availability and pagination after a restore using a small fixture library.

## Safe verification

Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` in a configured test environment. Run `python3 scripts/source-preflight.py` for dependency-free JavaScript/Python syntax checks once available. Verify public browsing separately from protected moderation routes. Do not run crawlers or forced analysis merely to validate a documentation change.

Run `python3 scripts/check-local-setup.py` for a local configuration check (or static HTTP check for photobooth). This does not authenticate to remote providers or launch an application workload.

## Reproduce before changing data

Load the public archive, filter by member/year, load another page, save a favorite and reload. With authorized test moderator access, verify a synthetic report is visible and moderation routes reject unauthenticated requests.

Use fixture data and an isolated deployment. Keep the last working revision available. Record the runtime, affected route/provider and error status before retrying. Do not repeatedly retry a rate-limited upstream.

## Information safe to share

Never attach R2 credentials, admin review keys, session secrets, private reports or exported moderation state. Redact private object URLs and reporter information.

## After a recovery

Recheck the failing journey and one normal journey, confirm that persisted/browser-local data is still available where expected, and document any steps that could not be exercised.
